There's obviously an issue/oversight somewhere, otherwise the linter wouldn't complain. it's just that `mypy` now properly checks the type, while the ssz container seems to be read as `Any`, once you would run FCR for gloas you would get a runtime error though https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5218 CI is green now but we can close that, was just to demonstrate the issue
